parameters.jsCode: const r=$json||{},h=r.headers||{},b=r.body&&typeof r.body==='object'?r.body:r; const token=String(h.authorization||h.Authorization||'').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i,''); if(!$env.N8N_WORKFLOWS_TOKEN||token!==$env.N8N_WORKFLOWS_TOKEN) throw new Error('unauthorized'); const crypto=require('crypto'); const trace_id=String(b.trace_id||crypto.randomUUID()); const context_id=crypto.randomUUID(); const realm=String(b.realm||$env.N8N_REALM||$env.N8N_ENV_REALM||'aiops'); const request=String(b.request||b.text||'').trim(); if(!request) throw new Error('request is required'); let origin=String($env.N8N_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL||r.webhookUrl||'').replace(/\/webhook\/.*$/,'').replace(/\/api\/v1$/,'').replace(/\/+$/,''); const host=(origin.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/:]+)/)||[])[1]||''; const privateHost=host==='localhost'||host==='127.0.0.1'||/^10\./.test(host)||/^192\.168\./.test(host)||/^172\.(1[6-9]|2\d|3[0-1])\./.test(host); if(!privateHost) origin=origin.replace(/:5678$/,''); return [{json:{trace_id,context_id,realm,request,preview_url:origin+'/webhook/jobs/preview'}}];

parameters.query: WITH ctx AS (INSERT INTO aiops_context(context_id,source,reply_target,actor,normalized_event,status) VALUES ('{{ $json.context_id }}'::uuid,'codex-ui','{}'::jsonb,jsonb_build_object('type','codex-ui'),jsonb_build_object('source','codex-ui','text','{{ String($json.request).replace(/'/g, "''") }}','trace_id','{{ String($json.trace_id).replace(/'/g, "''") }}','realm','{{ String($json.realm).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'),'open') ON CONFLICT(context_id) DO NOTHING), ev AS (INSERT INTO aiops_execution_events(trace_id,phase,status,message,metadata) VALUES ('{{ String($json.trace_id).replace(/'/g, "''") }}','accepted','completed','要求を受け付けました',jsonb_build_object('realm','{{ String($json.realm).replace(/'/g, "''") }}')) RETURNING event_id,trace_id) SELECT ev.event_id,ev.trace_id,'{{ $json.context_id }}' AS context_id,'{{ String($json.realm).replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS realm,'{{ String($json.request).replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS request,'{{ String($json.preview_url).replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS preview_url FROM ev;

WITH ins AS (INSERT INTO aiops_execution_events(trace_id,phase,status,message,metadata) VALUES ('{{ String($json.trace_id).replace(/'/g, "''") }}','collecting_context','running','関連情報を収集しています',jsonb_build_object('realm','{{ String($json.realm).replace(/'/g, "''") }}')),('{{ String($json.trace_id).replace(/'/g, "''") }}','planning','running','AIが対応案を作成しています','{}'::jsonb) RETURNING event_id) SELECT MAX(event_id) AS event_id,'{{ String($json.trace_id).replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS trace_id,'{{ $json.context_id }}' AS context_id,'{{ String($json.realm).replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS realm,'{{ String($json.request).replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS request,'{{ String($json.preview_url).replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS preview_url FROM ins;

parameters.query: WITH ins AS (INSERT INTO aiops_execution_events(trace_id,phase,status,message,metadata) VALUES ('{{ String($node["Record Processing"].json.trace_id).replace(/'/g, "''") }}','collecting_context',CASE WHEN NULLIF('{{ String($json.error || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}','') IS NULL THEN 'completed' ELSE 'failed' END,CASE WHEN NULLIF('{{ String($json.error || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}','') IS NULL THEN '関連情報の収集が完了しました' ELSE '関連情報の収集に失敗しました' END,'{}'::jsonb),('{{ String($node["Record Processing"].json.trace_id).replace(/'/g, "''") }}','planning',CASE WHEN NULLIF('{{ String($json.error || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}','') IS NULL THEN 'completed' ELSE 'failed' END,CASE WHEN NULLIF('{{ String($json.error || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}','') IS NULL THEN 'AIが対応案を作成しました' ELSE 'AI対応案の作成に失敗しました' END,jsonb_build_object('result',COALESCE(NULLIF('{{ JSON.stringify($json).replace(/'/g, "''") }}','undefined')::jsonb,'{}'::jsonb))) RETURNING event_id,trace_id,phase,status,message) SELECT event_id,trace_id,phase,status,message FROM ins ORDER BY event_id DESC LIMIT 1;

parameters.jsCode: const r=$json||{},h=r.headers||{},q=r.query||{}; const token=String(h.authorization||h.Authorization||'').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i,''); if(!$env.N8N_WORKFLOWS_TOKEN||token!==$env.N8N_WORKFLOWS_TOKEN) throw new Error('unauthorized'); const scope=String(q.scope||'trace').toLowerCase()==='all'?'all':'trace'; const trace_id=String(q.trace_id||'').trim(); if(scope==='trace'&&!trace_id) throw new Error('trace_id is required'); return [{json:{scope,trace_id,after:Math.max(0,Number(q.after||0)||0),since_seconds:Math.min(3600,Math.max(0,Number(q.since_seconds||0)||0))}}];

parameters.query: WITH scope_max AS (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(event_id),{{ Number($json.after)||0 }}) AS latest_cursor FROM aiops_execution_events WHERE ('{{ String($json.scope).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'='all' OR trace_id='{{ String($json.trace_id).replace(/'/g, "''") }}')), selected AS (SELECT event_id,trace_id,job_id,phase,status,message,metadata,created_at FROM aiops_execution_events WHERE event_id>{{ Number($json.after)||0 }} AND ('{{ String($json.scope).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'='all' OR trace_id='{{ String($json.trace_id).replace(/'/g, "''") }}') AND ({{ Number($json.since_seconds)||0 }}=0 OR created_at>=NOW()-make_interval(secs=>{{ Number($json.since_seconds)||0 }})) ORDER BY event_id ASC LIMIT 200) SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(selected) ORDER BY event_id),'[]'::jsonb) AS events,COALESCE(MAX(event_id),{{ Number($json.after)||0 }}) AS cursor,(SELECT latest_cursor FROM scope_max) AS latest_cursor FROM selected;

parameters.jsCode: const r=$json||{},h=r.headers||{},q=r.query||{}; const token=String(h.authorization||h.Authorization||'').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i,''); if(!$env.N8N_WORKFLOWS_TOKEN||token!==$env.N8N_WORKFLOWS_TOKEN) throw new Error('unauthorized'); const trace_id=String(q.trace_id||'').trim(); if(!trace_id) throw new Error('trace_id is required'); return [{json:{trace_id}}];

parameters.query: SELECT q.job_id,q.status,q.started_at,q.finished_at,q.result_payload,q.error_payload FROM (VALUES (1)) seed(n) LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM ((SELECT 1 AS priority,jq.job_id,jq.status,jq.started_at,jq.finished_at,jr.result_payload,jr.error_payload FROM aiops_job_queue jq LEFT JOIN aiops_job_results jr ON jr.job_id=jq.job_id WHERE jq.trace_id='{{ String($json.trace_id).replace(/'/g, "''") }}' ORDER BY jq.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) UNION ALL (SELECT 2,NULL::uuid,CASE WHEN e.status='completed' THEN 'success' ELSE e.status END,NULL::timestamptz,e.created_at,e.metadata->'result',CASE WHEN e.status='failed' THEN e.metadata ELSE NULL END FROM aiops_execution_events e WHERE e.trace_id='{{ String($json.trace_id).replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AND e.phase='planning' AND e.status IN ('completed','failed') ORDER BY e.event_id DESC LIMIT 1)) candidates ORDER BY priority LIMIT 1) q ON true;

parameters.jsCode: const r=$json||{},h=r.headers||{},b=r.body&&typeof r.body==='object'?r.body:r; const bearer=String(h.authorization||h.Authorization||'').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i,''); const observer=String(h['x-observer-token']||h['X-Observer-Token']||''); const authorized=($env.N8N_WORKFLOWS_TOKEN&&bearer===$env.N8N_WORKFLOWS_TOKEN)||($env.N8N_OBSERVER_TOKEN&&observer===$env.N8N_OBSERVER_TOKEN); if(!authorized) throw new Error('unauthorized'); const raw=b.event&&typeof b.event==='object'?b.event:{}; const phase=String(raw.phase||'').toLowerCase(); const source=String(raw.source||''); const target=String(raw.target||''); const items=Array.isArray(raw.items)?raw.items:[]; const isAI=(name)=>/(openai|ai agent|llm|chat model|language model)/i.test(String(name||'')); const deep=(value,key,depth=0)=>{if(depth>7||value==null)return null;if(Array.isArray(value)){for(const entry of value){const found=deep(entry,key,depth+1);if(found!=null&&found!=='')return found;}return null;}if(typeof value==='object'){if(value[key]!=null&&value[key]!=='')return value[key];for(const entry of Object.values(value)){const found=deep(entry,key,depth+1);if(found!=null&&found!=='')return found;}}return null;}; const execution_id=String(b.execution_id||'unknown'); const trace_id=String(deep(items,'trace_id')||deep(items,'traceId')||`n8n-exec-${execution_id}`); const realm=String(b.realm||$env.N8N_REALM||$env.N8N_ENV_REALM||'aiops'); const workflow=String(b.workflow||'unknown'); const events=[]; const add=(eventPhase,status,message,node,channel=null)=>events.push({trace_id,phase:eventPhase,status,message:String(message||'').slice(0,1000),metadata:{realm,workflow,execution_id,ai_node:node||null,channel,observer_kind:String(b.kind||''),sent_at:b.sent_at||null}}); const item=items.find(v=>v&&typeof v==='object')||{}; const hasError=Boolean(deep(items,'error')); if(phase==='before'&&isAI(target)) add('ai_node','running',`AIノード開始: ${target}`,target); if(phase==='after'&&isAI(source)) add('ai_node',hasError?'failed':'completed',hasError?`AIノード失敗: ${source}`:`AIノード完了: ${source}`,source); if(phase==='before'&&/OpenAI Chat Core/i.test(target)){const actor=item.actor||{};const normalized=item.normalized_event||{};const text=String(normalized.original_text||normalized.text||'').split('\n\n')[0].trim();if(text)add('channel_message','completed',`${String(actor.full_name||actor.name||'利用者')}: ${text}`,target,'zulip');} if(phase==='before'&&/Respond Deferred \(Zulip\)/i.test(target)) add('channel_message','completed','AIOps エージェント: 後でメッセンジャーでお伝えします。',target,'zulip'); if(phase==='before'&&/Post to Zulip/i.test(target)){const content=String(item.content||deep(items,'content')||'').trim();if(content)add('channel_message','completed',`AIOps エージェント: ${content}`,target,'zulip');} return [{json:{ok:true,events}}];

parameters.query: WITH resolved AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT e.trace_id FROM aiops_execution_events e WHERE e.metadata->>'execution_id'='{{ String($json.metadata?.execution_id||'').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AND e.trace_id NOT LIKE 'n8n-exec-%' ORDER BY e.event_id ASC LIMIT 1),'{{ String($json.trace_id).replace(/'/g, "''") }}') AS trace_id), ins AS (INSERT INTO aiops_execution_events(trace_id,phase,status,message,metadata) SELECT r.trace_id,'{{ String($json.phase).replace(/'/g, "''") }}','{{ String($json.status).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',('{{ JSON.stringify(String($json.message||'')).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb #>> '{}'),'{{ JSON.stringify($json.metadata||{}).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb FROM resolved r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aiops_execution_events e WHERE e.trace_id=r.trace_id AND e.phase='{{ String($json.phase).replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AND e.status='{{ String($json.status).replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AND e.message=('{{ JSON.stringify(String($json.message||'')).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb #>> '{}') AND e.metadata->>'execution_id'='{{ String($json.metadata?.execution_id||'').replace(/'/g, "''") }}') RETURNING event_id,trace_id,phase,status,message) SELECT * FROM ins;

if(!(($env.N8N_WORKFLOWS_TOKEN&&bearer===$env.N8N_WORKFLOWS_TOKEN)||($env.N8N_OBSERVER_TOKEN&&observer===$env.N8N_OBSERVER_TOKEN))) return []; const raw=b.event&&typeof b.event==='object'?b.event:{}; const phase=String(raw.phase||'').toLowerCase(); const source=String(raw.source||''); const target=String(raw.target||''); const items=Array.isArray(raw.items)?raw.items:[]; const item=items.find(v=>v&&typeof v==='object')||{}; let message=''; if(phase==='after'&&source==='Normalize Duplicate Flag'&&String(item.source||item.normalized_event?.source||'')==='zulip'){const actor=item.actor||{};const normalized=item.normalized_event||{};const text=String(normalized.original_text||normalized.text||'').split('\n\n')[0].trim();if(text)message=`${String(actor.full_name||actor.name||'利用者')}: ${text}`;} if(phase==='before'&&target==='Zulip Deferred Reply') message='AIOps エージェント: 後でメッセンジャーでお伝えします。'; if(!message)return []; const deep=(value,key,depth=0)=>{if(depth>7||value==null)return null;if(Array.isArray(value)){for(const entry of value){const found=deep(entry,key,depth+1);if(found!=null&&found!=='')return found;}return null;}if(typeof value==='object'){if(value[key]!=null&&value[key]!=='')return value[key];for(const entry of Object.values(value)){const found=deep(entry,key,depth+1);if(found!=null&&found!=='')return found;}}return null;}; const execution_id=String(b.execution_id||'unknown'); const trace_id=String(deep(items,'trace_id')||deep(items,'traceId')||`n8n-exec-${execution_id}`); return [{json:{trace_id,phase:'channel_message',status:'completed',message:message.slice(0,1000),metadata:{realm:String(b.realm||$env.N8N_REALM||$env.N8N_ENV_REALM||'aiops'),workflow:String(b.workflow||'unknown'),execution_id,ai_node:null,channel:'zulip',observer_kind:String(b.kind||''),sent_at:b.sent_at||null}}}];
